maria: Heads-up: postmortem follow-up for 2024-04-10 incident — need to lock owners for action items. Quick sync?
aj: Thanks. I pulled a list into the doc, but we need owners + JIRA ids.
maria: Pasting items here and assigning provisional owners. We'll create JIRA tickets today.
kevin: Quick q — which items are blocking the SLA fix vs docs/training?
maria: Blocking = 1) autoscaler policy tweak 2) prefix-cache eviction fix. Non-blocking = runbook updates & onboarding notes.
sarah: I'll take runbook updates (creating INF-4241).
kyle: I'll take autoscaler policy (INF-4240) — ETA EOW. Need access to staging cluster.
aj: RACI sketch: kyle = R, infra-eng = A, maria = C, aj = I.
oncall-bot: Incident 2024-04-10 remediation checklist created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4240
maria: @kevin can you pair with @kyle on cache eviction? That's tricky across models.
kevin: Yep. 1hr pairing tomorrow 10:00am PT. I'll add to calendar.
sarah: For docs I created INF-4241 and linked to postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4241
aj: Add recurring pattern to backlog: 'cache thrash on long-seq batches' — pass to Optimize team.
maria: Added tag `recurring-pattern` and set quarterly review with research/ref teams.
kyle: Handoff: once autoscaler patch merges, request SRE watch the canary 48h.
maria: Assign SRE watch — @oncall (RACI: SRE = R, kyle = C).
aj: Owners please update JIRA 'Remediation owner' + ETA by EOD.
sarah: :thumbsup: updating INF-4241 now.
kevin: Note for runbook: command used during incident `kubectl top pods --sort-by=cpu` — add to diagnostics section.
maria: Recap: INF-4240 (autoscaler) — kyle (R) ETA EOW; INF-4241 (runbook) — sarah (R) ETA 2d; INF-4242 (db review) — created as dependent by kyle.
aj: I'll create the weekly check-in recurring reminder (Tue 9am PT).
oncall-bot: Reminder created: 'Postmortem follow-up check' every Tue 9:00am PT.
kyle: FYI opened INF-4242 and pinged DB team: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4242
maria: Closing loop — owners update tickets + PRs set to needs-review and tag `remediation`. Reconvene next Wed 11am PT unless blockers.
aj: I'll send calendar invite. Thanks everyone.
kevin: Closing — thanks, will update pairing notes in INF-4240.
